faq.heading: What to know before the check

items.a: You upload your utility-cost statement as a PDF or photo. It is checked automatically against the German Operating Costs Ordinance (BetrKV), the Heating Costs Ordinance (HeizkV) and Federal Court (BGH) case law. You get an overview of the issues found with an estimated refund potential – and, if you like, ready-made template letters (objection or request to inspect the supporting documents).

The first check with a preview – number of issues and estimated potential – is free. The full report including the reasoning for each point and the ready-made template letters costs a one-off €9.90. No subscription, no hidden fees.

Typical examples are non-allocable costs such as administration or repair costs (§ 1 BetrKV), incorrect distribution of heating costs (§ 7 HeizkV), vacancy costs charged to tenants, missed billing deadlines or items that cannot be traced.

No. Nebenkostencheck is an automated tool and does not constitute legal advice within the meaning of the German Legal Services Act (RDG). The results are non-binding assessments without guarantee and do not replace advice from a lawyer.

items.q: How long can I object to the statement?
items.a: You can raise objections to the utility-cost statement up to the end of the twelfth month after you receive it (§ 556 (3) BGB) – even if you have already paid the amount demanded.

items.q: What happens to my uploaded bill?
items.a: Your bill is processed solely for the check and is deleted automatically no later than 24 hours after upload. After a purchase, the report remains available for up to 7 days. No user account is required. Details are in the privacy policy.
PDF files or photos (e.g. JPG or PNG) of your bill, up to 3 MB. It is best to upload only the actual utility-cost statement, not the entire correspondence.

sections.heading: What data we process
sections.body: We process the utility-cost statement you upload (as a PDF or image file) as well as the details extracted from it (e.g. line items, amounts, periods). When you purchase the full report, the payment data required to process the transaction is additionally processed.

sections.heading: Hosting (Vercel)
sections.body: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc. (440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA). When you access the site, technically necessary connection data (IP address, time of access, page requested, browser) is processed in server logs. A data processing agreement is in place with Vercel; the transfer to the USA is based on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Art. 46 (2) (c) GDPR). Further information: https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy.

sections.heading: Processing by Anthropic (Claude)
sections.body: The file you upload is transmitted to Anthropic (Claude API) for the automated check. The server location is, among others, in the USA; this therefore constitutes a transfer to a third country under Art. 44 et seq. GDPR. Under its terms of use, Anthropic undertakes not to use data to train models (API usage). Further information: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy. The transfer is based on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, which form part of the Anthropic Data Processing Addendum.

sections.heading: Temporary storage (Upstash)
sections.body: Check results, the contact details you enter in the letter form (name, address, contract number) and any letters generated are stored temporarily in a database operated by Upstash, Inc. (2261 Market Street #4032, San Francisco, CA 94114, USA). This is based on a data processing agreement and the EU Standard Contractual Clauses. The data is deleted automatically (see “Storage & deletion”).

sections.heading: Storage & deletion
sections.body: Check results are stored temporarily on our servers and deleted automatically no later than 24 hours after upload. After a purchase, the report remains available for up to 7 days and is then deleted automatically. If a payment has not yet been completed (e.g. SEPA direct debit), the record is retained for up to 14 days until the payment has been confirmed or declined. Your statement is never stored permanently. Letters generated are deleted together with the report.

sections.heading: Payment processing (Stripe)
sections.body: Payments are processed by the payment service provider Stripe, Inc. (185 Berry Street, Suite 550, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA). The payment data required for the transaction is transmitted to Stripe. Stripe is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. Further information: https://stripe.com/de/privacy.

sections.heading: Email delivery (IONOS)
sections.body: If you have a generated letter sent to you by email, the email address you provide is transmitted together with the PDF via the mail server of IONOS SE (Elgendorfer Str. 57, 56410 Montabaur, Germany). The address is not used for any other purpose.

sections.heading: Abuse prevention (IP address)
sections.body: To protect against automated bulk requests, we store your IP address in a counter for a maximum of 48 hours (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR – legitimate interest in operating the service).

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: Your data is processed on the basis of Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR (performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures). Where you initiate processing of the file by Anthropic, your consent applies pursuant to Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body:
You have the right to access the data stored about you (Art. 15 GDPR), to rectification of inaccurate data (Art. 16 GDPR), to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR) and to object to processing (Art. 21 GDPR). You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data protection supervisory authority.

If you have any questions, please contact: kontakt@nebenkostencheck24.de

sections.heading: 1. Description of service
sections.body: Nebenkostencheck provides an automated check of utility-cost statements as well as the creation of template letters (objection, request to inspect documents). The check is based on the relevant legal provisions (including BetrKV, HeizkV) and the case law of the highest courts.

sections.heading: 2. Not legal advice
sections.body: The service is an automated tool and does not constitute legal advice within the meaning of the German Legal Services Act (RDG). The results are non-binding assessments without guarantee and do not replace advice from a lawyer.

sections.heading: 3. Price
sections.body: Unlocking the full check report including the template letters costs a one-off €9.90. Pursuant to § 19 UStG (small-business rule), no VAT is shown. The first check with a preview is free.

sections.heading: 4. Right of withdrawal and early expiry
sections.body: Consumers generally have a 14-day right of withdrawal. However, for digital content and services the right of withdrawal expires if the customer has expressly agreed to immediate performance and confirmed knowledge that, by agreeing, they lose their right of withdrawal once performance begins (§ 356 (5) BGB). This consent is obtained expressly before payment.

sections.heading: 5. Liability
sections.body: We accept no warranty for the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of the check results and generated letters. Stated amounts are estimates and may differ from refunds actually obtainable. Liability for damages arising from the use of the results is excluded to the extent permitted by law.
